prose.subject: Invoice INV-63119 from Thornbury Supply
prose.body:
Dear Fallowfield Games Team,

Please find attached invoice INV-63119 for recent supply services rendered. The total amount due is 8409.66 USDC.

Line Items:
1. Standard Logistics Package: 5000.00 USDC
2. Component Restocking Fee: 3409.66 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days of the issue date. Please remit funds to our standard business account:

Account: 0x7e42db347813d5c835feb28bf65134c33a1d99ce

Kindly reference the invoice number INV-63119 in your payment description to ensure proper reconciliation. If you have any questions regarding these charges or the breakdown of costs, please contact our accounts department at billing@thornbury-supply.example.

Thank you for your continued partnership with Thornbury Supply.

Sincerely,

Thornbury Supply Finance Department
